reviews.title: No story, no mystery, just a whoooole lotta names
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Unfortunately this book is not what I hoped- there’s no plot, no motive, no story, just list upon list of names. Even the book’s page order is strange- why are the names divided into abstract case files? Why are the clues at the back? Why are the pages not numbered?The title and cover are so inviting- I expected to be really reading clues about these characters - not just clues about their names.Also, the book really is a waste of paper- the first several clues just blanket eliminate over 60 pages of names- it makes me wonder why are they even there/printed if we don’t do any work with them?The clues start to get ridiculous- what mystery fan wants to comb through 20,000 remaining names and cross off the ones beginning with an S??? This is tedious and mind-numbing work.Can only give 1 star because at least the AI-generated names are diverse (even if comically so).Read moreRead less
